feedback: The confession follows the decisive pre-vote contradiction exactly: Monet's visit had to be after the preview because the unwrapped glass did not yet exist at the claimed earlier time. Taking poison from the bottle is confirmation of the inferred mechanism rather than a new clue needed to identify her. Her payroll justification is emotionally credible, especially the contrast between wages already paid and a family losing Grant. Chip and Barb receive consequences grounded in their admitted misconduct, which makes the supporting finale useful. Monet does explain the inference very explicitly, but after voting that feels appropriate and earned. The confession does not repair an essential missing logical link.
